oncall-bot: Pager triggered — INC-2026-03-17-1. Elevated 5xx errors from eu-embedding-cluster (rate ~18% of requests). Auto-escalation to oncall.
maria: I'm oncall. joining audio now. assigning tj to lead mitigation. creating incident page draft.
tj: taking lead. initial hypothesis: degraded NVMe on a shard causing slow KV reads, fallbacks timing out. spinning up fallback route to s1-replica.
maria: draft status page below — needs ops/legal quick review before publish. publishing will notify subscribers.
ops-scribe: ```
Impact: Partial degradation of embeddings endpoint affecting some EU regions.
Started: 2026-03-17 14:11 UTC
Current status: Investigating
Customer impact: Elevated error rates for embeddings requests in eu-west-1 and eu-central-1; text generations unaffected.
Mitigation: Routing subset of traffic to s1-replica and increasing retry budget.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have new info.
```
legal: quick note — avoid implying data loss. prefer "service degradation" and confirm "embeddings requests" phrasing. remove any PII language.
emily: ops acked. no customer data exposure confirmed. good to publish initial with legal wording.
ryan: add short note for Dedicated customers: "Customers on Dedicated capacity may see increased latency; we will reach out if SLA impact expected." keeps expectations clear.
maria: updated draft with legal + dedicated note. ready to publish. preview: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-03-17-1-preview

maria: posting periodic update draft: "Mitigation implemented; error rate reduced. Monitoring. Next update in 30m or when resolved." anyone object?
ops-scribe: +1. add "no customer data affected" sentence per legal.
maria: posted periodic update.
tj: metrics look stable after 12m. keeping oncall watch for another 15m. plan to de-escalate if stable for 15.
